candidates.summary: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.

candidates.title: Consumers to Ramp up Holiday Spending This Year: KPMG
candidates.summary: Julia Wilson, Principal of Consumer and Retail Strategy at KPMG US, discusses the firm’s holiday survey, which projects spending will increase 5% year over year. She says much of the rise reflects higher prices, though consumers are still willing to spend on priorities. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

candidates.title: Investors Figuring Out Agentic AI: Robinhood's Guild
candidates.summary: Stephanie Guild, CIO of Robinhood, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how she is seeing consumers take advantage of the pullback in AI, having cash on the side to invest, and how Robinhood users can now use agentic AI agents to invest on their behalf. (Source: Bloomberg)

candidates.title: Quick Study
candidates.summary: Tool: Quick Study Prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 High : Build an artifact where you open a photo and it rapidly (in a few seconds) paints a version of that photo using a canvas element and simulated paintbrush See also my previous experiment getting Claude Fable to simulate a watercolor illustration with P5.js. Quick Study uses Sobel edge detection , with no external libraries beyond Google Fonts. Tags: tools

candidates.title: AlixPartners Co-CEO Rob Hornby on AI Bull Case
candidates.summary: Rob Hornby says AI costs are falling faster than those of comparable technologies historically, but remain substantial. He describes companies as being in a transition period: investment is underway while returns are uneven, and the shift from flat fees to per-token charges has exposed costs. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
